text.p: California Microwave Inc Monday said it promoted Gilbert Johnson, 65, to the post of president and chief operating officer, a new position for the company.
In a statement, the satellite and wireless communications company said Johnson reports to California Microwave's chairman and chief executive officer, Philip Otto.
California Microwave said Johnson has held a wide variety of operating positions at the firm since he joined the company in 1973.

The move comes about a month after Clover Capital Management Inc, a large shareholder in California Microwave, recommended that Otto be replaced because the company's credibility had suffered because Otto's earnings forecasts have failed to materialize.
Clover holds a 7.7 percent stake in California Microwave.
